title: crosstalk / infrastructure
description: Host, containers, Postgres, logs and the monitoring stack for the single-machine compose deployment.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: Share of all host cores not idle.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal.

panels.title: Root disk used
panels.description: Host root filesystem; holds the Postgres named volume and the blob store bind mount.

targets.expr: max(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}))

panels.title: Root disk full in
panels.description: Linear extrapolation (predict_linear over 6h) of free space on / to zero. Empty when free space is flat or growing.

targets.expr: min(predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}[6h], 0) / (predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}[6h], 0) - predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}[6h], 3600))) > 0

panels.title: Root disk used % and forecast
panels.description: Forecast line: what used % would be in 12h if the last 6h trend continued.

targets.expr: max(100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}))

max(100 * (1 - predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}[6h], 12 * 3600) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs"}))

panels.title: Network (rx up, tx down)
panels.description: Physical interfaces only; container bridges and veths are excluded (see the Containers row).

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: 1.0 = one full core.

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Dashed lines are compose mem_limit values; services without a limit have no dashed line.

panels.title: Restarts (15m window)
panels.description: Changes in container start time per service over a sliding 15m window. A compose recreate also counts once.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since each service's container last started.

panels.title: Block IO (read up, write down)
panels.description: Per-cgroup block device IO (cAdvisor diskIO metrics).

panels.title: Postgres
panels.description: pg_up: whether postgres-exporter could connect on its last scrape.

panels.title: Longest open transaction
panels.description: Max age of any open transaction (pg_stat_activity.xact_start), excluding autovacuum.

panels.title: Longest transaction by state
panels.description: 'idle in transaction' that keeps growing means a client holds a transaction open (blocks vacuum).

panels.title: Top statements by total time (dashboard range)
panels.description: pg_stat_statements via postgres-exporter --collector.stat_statements. The query column is only filled when the exporter also runs with --collector.stat_statements.include_query; otherwise join on queryid in psql.

targets.expr: ((topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])))) + on (queryid) group_left (query) (0 * topk by (queryid) (1, pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="postgres"}))) or on (queryid) (topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range]))))

((sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) and on (queryid, datname, user) topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])))) + on (queryid) group_left (query) (0 * topk by (queryid) (1, pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="postgres"}))) or on (queryid) (sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) and on (queryid, datname, user) topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range]))))

((1000 * sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) / (sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) > 0) and on (queryid, datname, user) topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])))) + on (queryid) group_left (query) (0 * topk by (queryid) (1, pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="postgres"}))) or on (queryid) (1000 * sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) / (sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) > 0) and on (queryid, datname, user) topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range]))))

((sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_rows_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) and on (queryid, datname, user) topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])))) + on (queryid) group_left (query) (0 * topk by (queryid) (1, pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="postgres"}))) or on (queryid) (sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_rows_total{job="postgres"}[$__range])) and on (queryid, datname, user) topk(20, sum by (queryid, datname, user) (increase(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="postgres"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Errors and warnings/s by service
panels.description: Services whose JSON logs carry a `level` field (crosstalk, migrate, ui: Alloy lifts it to a stream label) are counted by level. Every other line is matched against (?i)error|panic|fatal.

panels.title: Logs: $service
panels.description: Filter by the $service and $search variables.

panels.title: Rule evaluation
panels.description: No Alertmanager: firing alerts are visible here and under Alerting in Grafana / Prometheus /alerts.

panels.title: Metrics endpoint
panels.description: Scrape of crosstalk:9464. Application metrics live on a separate dashboard.

panels.title: Open FDs, sockets, threads
panels.description: Requires cAdvisor's `process` metric set (disabled by default; see deploy notes). Empty otherwise.
